exercises.prompt: Select the correct phrase for 'four books' (كِتَابٌ is masculine):
exercises.explanation: Numbers 3–10 take the opposite gender of the singular noun (كِتَابٌ masc. → أَرْبَعَةُ fem.) and a plural genitive counted noun (كُتُبٍ).

feedback.rule: 3–10: reverse gender + plural genitive counted noun.

exercises.prompt: What case and number does the counted noun take after numbers 11–99 (e.g., عِشْرُونَ _____)?
exercises.explanation: All numbers from 11 to 99 govern a singular accusative counted noun (tamyīz).

feedback.rule: 11–99 take singular accusative; 3–10 take plural genitive; 100/1000 take singular genitive.
